Question: 在下列实例中，分别属于相对性状和性状分离的是____

①羊的长角与短腿
②水稻的非糯性和糯性
③兔的粗毛和狗的细毛
④高茎豌豆与矮茎豌豆杂交,后代全为高茎豌豆
⑤开红花的牡丹与开白花的牡丹杂交,后代全开粉红花
⑥白毛兔与白毛兔杂交后代中出现了灰毛兔
Options:
A. ②⑥
B. ②④
C. ①⑤
D. ③⑤

Need identify which are relative traits (相对性状) and which is trait segregation (性状分离), respectively. Phrase "分别属于相对性状和性状分离的是" means first item belongs to relative traits, second belongs to trait segregation. Options pairs (trait example, segregation example). Need choose pair: first is relative trait, second is trait segregation.

Definition: relative traits: same species, same trait, different manifestations. ① sheep long horns and short legs: same species? sheep, but different traits (horn length vs leg length) not relative trait. ② rice non-waxy and waxy: same species, same trait (amylose property?) different manifestation, relative trait. ③ rabbit coarse hair and dog fine hair: different species, not relative trait. ④ tall pea x dwarf pea, offspring all tall: demonstrates dominance, not segregation? It is hybridization, not trait separation. ⑤ red flower peony x white flower peony, offspring all pink: incomplete dominance, not trait separation (segregation? In genetics, trait segregation: in offspring of selfing/hybridization? Usually 性状分离: in the offspring of a cross between individuals with the same trait, both dominant and recessive traits appear? More broadly: appearance of different traits in offspring of parents with same trait. Or in F1 selfing, F2 shows dominant and recessive. ⑤ parents different colors, offspring pink, not separation. ⑥ white-rabbit x white-rabbit offspring appears gray rabbit: parents same trait, offspring different trait, this is trait segregation? Let's verify: 白毛兔与白毛兔杂交后代中出现了灰毛兔. If white is dominant? Offspring gray appears; this is trait separation: offspring of same phenotype show different phenotypes. Yes. So relative trait = ②; trait separation = ⑥. Option A.

But let's double-check potential nuance: ④ high x dwarf all high is not 性状分离, it's 显性现象. ⑤ red x white all pink is 不完全显性, not 性状分离. ⑥ white x white -> gray is 性状分离? Sometimes 性状分离 definition: 杂种后代中同时出现显性性状和隐性性状的现象. Here white x white, gray appears; if white and gray are alleles, F1? If parents are heterozygous? It is segregation. Good.
